reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "TLS.CAOptional: Docker provider `tls.CAOptional` option has been removed in v3, as TLS client authentication is a server side option (see…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: If the Docker provider static configuration still sets tls.caOptional (file, CLI flag, or environment variable), the option no longer exists in v3 and the configured value stops being honoured; the upgrade guide's remediation is to remove it from the Docker provider static configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove the tls.caOptional option from the Docker provider static configuration, in whichever form it is set: --providers.docker.tls.caOptional CLI flag, providers.docker.tls.caOptional in traefik.yml/traefik.yaml, or caOptional under [providers.docker.tls] in traefik.toml.

proposed.statement: The Docker provider static-configuration option tls.caOptional (providers.docker.tls.caOptional, CLI --providers.docker.tls.caOptional) has been removed in Traefik v3 and must be removed from the Docker provider static configuration.
